newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance firms, bucking trend on Delhi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Reliance firms, bucking trend on Delhi bourse.

text.p: Reliance Industries jumped higher as Delhi share prices drifted lower in mixed afternoon trade on Monday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was 1.09 points lower at 803.26 at 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT).
Brokers said speculators and foreign investors snapped up shares in Reliance Industries in anticipation that the company might announce a bonus share issue.
"Hectic buying activity in Reliance Industries was the main highlight of the trade so far," said Shree Bhagwan Garg of brokers Mean Leasing.
Traders said heavy selling by country's leading financial institution, Unit Trust of India, pushed down other share prices.
They said a slide in index heavyweight Hindustan Lever helped to pull down the benchmark index.
Hindustan Lever dropped 14 rupees to 1,224 on profit-taking, brokers said.
State Bank of India gained 1.50 rupees to 315.
ITC was one rupee lower at 482.
